annotations.title: Solana Transaction Lookup: Status, Fee, Balance Changes

description: Look up a confirmed Solana transaction by signature: success or error, time, fee, signers, programs used, and the resulting SOL and token balance changes per account. Public on-chain data; not advice. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
